findings.title: Auto-Dreamer paper localizes the missing historical replay package to concrete run-export files
findings.observation: The paper explicitly names a frozen episodes.jsonl plus per_task.jsonl, trajectories.jsonl, dreamer_calls.jsonl and summary.json. The historical replay gap is therefore localized to a specific unlocated export package rather than an unspecified missing trace.
findings.scope_guard: Paper-described logging semantics are not proof that the historical files are publicly released or immutable-bound to the reported run.

findings.title: Reported ScienceWorld online evaluation uses a frozen 660-task subset rather than the full public test trace corpus
findings.observation: The paper specifies 660 tasks across seven sampled task types with seed 42, shuffle-tasks and frozen episodes.jsonl, whereas the public trace-corpus README reports 1,819 ScienceWorld test episodes. Evaluation-population identity therefore requires the frozen episode manifest or an equivalent derivation mapping.
findings.scope_guard: The 1,819-row trace corpus may legitimately be a superset or differently collected artifact; no corruption claim is made.

findings.title: Original ScienceWorld benchmark split statistics and public collected trace-corpus counts are not one-to-one identical
findings.observation: The paper reports original split counts of 3,604 train / 1,802 test, while the public trace-corpus README reports 3,592 train / 1,819 test episodes. A derivation manifest is therefore required before treating the trace corpus as byte/population-identical to the original benchmark split.
findings.scope_guard: Different counts may be expected because these surfaces describe different artifact classes; this is a provenance distinction, not a contradiction finding.

findings.title: Checkpoint card surfaces do not yet close evaluated-run binding and tree/history inspection hit a transient retrieval blocker
findings.observation: auto-dreamer-ckpt-bridge-public and dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60 are public; the latter exposes Qwen3/Safetensors/15B/BF16 metadata. The inspected card surfaces provide no paper-run, frozen-episode or consolidation-output binding. File-tree/history retrieval was cache/network blocked this invocation.
findings.scope_guard: The transient retrieval blocker is not evidence that a bridge manifest does not exist inside the repositories.

findings.title: Auto-Dreamer Hugging Face viewer schema failure makes raw-file binding preferable to viewer-derived tables
findings.observation: The generic Dataset Preview currently fails generation due to a heterogeneous-column casting mismatch. Raw-file identity plus file-specific schema should be used for static replay audits instead of a viewer-generated unified schema.
findings.scope_guard: Viewer failure is not evidence of corrupt raw JSONL.

protocol_status.reason: Existing p1-protocol-055, p1-protocol-061, p1-protocol-063 and p1-protocol-065 already fail-close the newly localized episode-population, checkpoint/run, intervention and verifier provenance gaps.

autodreamer_public_static_replay_frontie.accepted_scope: public primary-paper and immutable/source-addressable artifact audit without rerunning task agents, writer, dreamer, environment or hosted inference
autodreamer_public_static_replay_frontie.useful_outcome: the missing package is now specified at file/population granularity and can be searched/replayed statically if released

autodreamer_full_causal_replay.reason: The exact 660-task frozen episodes manifest, historical run-export bytes, checkpoint/run mapping, serialized rewrite transactions and environment/verifier binding are not yet co-located on the inspected public surface. Live reconstruction would require external model/compute execution and is not accepted.
